title: A computing pairing with retained flasque terms
statement: For every scheme $X$ and modules $F,G$, there exists a computing resolution pairing $D$ [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data] such that the underlying abelian sheaves of $D.left.K^n,D.right.K^n,D.target.K^n$ are flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque] for every $n\ge0$. No cover, cohomological degrees, flatness or quasi-coherence hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Use the MonoidalPreadditive proof in SheafOfModules.tensorClosed and obtain the strictly nonnegative flasque integer complexes K,L,M, quasi-isomorphic augmentations a,b,c and tensor cochain map t from moduleCup_godement_pairing. Restrict each complex along embeddingUpNat. The map from restriction to truncGE′ is an isomorphism for strictly supported complexes; truncGE preserves quasi-isomorphisms, hence restriction does too. Identify the restriction of the degree-zero single complex with single₀ to construct the natural-degree augmentations. Curry tensorSectionsMap followed by the tensor-summand inclusion and t to define the section pairing. Naturality of sheaf morphisms and tmulSection_map give restriction compatibility. The tensor differential formula on each summand, composed with the cochain identity of t, gives signed Leibniz. The two equality transports are proved by substitution, and the integer negOnePow becomes (-1)^r in natural degrees. The degree-zero equation of t supplies augmentation compatibility.

For each restricted flasque resolution choose the existing injectiveResolution of its coefficient sheaf and construct the comparison explicitly by InjectiveResolution.descOfQuasiIso applied to the identity. Its commutation theorem gives the over-augmentation equality and its existing instance proves that the comparison is a quasi-isomorphism. Global sections preserves finite limits by its evaluation construction. moduleCup_flasque_acyclicity makes the source terms right-acyclic, and Functor.rightAcyclic_of_injective makes the injective terms right-acyclic. Apply Functor.quasiIso_map_of_rightAcyclic_nat from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Abelian.RightDerived.Acyclic to obtain isomorphisms on every global homology group. Assemble these explicitly constructed computing resolutions and the section pairing into CupResolutionPairing.

The explicit restricted complexes retain the supplied flasqueness in every natural degree. Return the constructed pairing together with these three termwise flasque predicates. No arbitrary resolution witness is used in a definition.

theorem exists_cupCechFlasquePairing {X : Scheme.{uM}} (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ D : CupResolutionPairing F G,
      (∀ n : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (D.left.K.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (D.right.K.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (D.target.K.X n)))
